page_title: NOT 0-2 TOT | Nottingham Forest v Tottenham Hotspur 15/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' Tottenham will take a corner kick.
90+9' Substitution. Alejo Veliz receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) walks off.
90+8' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+8' Good work from Nottingham as they win a corner.
90+8' Neco Williams (Nottingham) takes a shot from inside the box and hits the right post!
90+7' Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
90+6' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.
90+6' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
90+5' The corner from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is intercepted by the defence.
90+5' The ball is cleared after Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Ball possession – 31:69.
90+3' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) takes a short corner kick.
90+2' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
90' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Emerson Royal (Tottenham) will replace Heung-Min Son.
88' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is penalised for a foul. Jarred Gillett had a clear view and blows his whistle.
88' A cross by Murillo (Nottingham) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.

85' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
85' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Nottingham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

85' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Guglielmo Vicario. The ball goes out for a corner. Nottingham can continue in their attacking effort.
85' Corner kick. Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is ready to send the ball into the box.

84' Neco Williams (Nottingham) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
84' A cross from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
83' Steven Cooper has decided to make a change. Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) replaces Orel Mangala.
82' The referee is firm and issues Murillo (Nottingham) a deserved yellow card.

81' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Matt Turner!
79' The game is interrupted. Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
79' The corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is intercepted by Matt Turner.

79' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Tottenham.
77' Neco Williams (Nottingham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
76' A corner kick by Nottingham is thwarted by the well prepared Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham).
75' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) fires a powerful shot which is blocked. Nottingham win a corner.
73' Ben Davies (Tottenham) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
73' Half-chance! Neco Williams (Nottingham) plays a pass into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario reacts well to snuff out the attack.
72' Substitution. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) on for Richarlison.
70' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Yves Bissouma (Tottenham). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

70' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Yves Bissouma (Tottenham), but referee Jarred Gillett must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
69' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
69' Danilo (Nottingham) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
68' Steven Cooper prepares a substitution. Cheikhou Kouyate is replaced by Danilo (Nottingham).
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Willy Boly as he is replaced by Chris Wood (Nottingham).
65' 0 - 2 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:2.
65' A pass into the box finds Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Matt Turner denies him.
64' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
63' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
63' A lofted cross from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
62' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
60' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Nottingham due to an offside in the build-up play.
59' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Nottingham players aren’t happy.

58' A superb goal from great team play! Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot straight into the roof of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
56' Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Jarred Gillett didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
54' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Nottingham will have a chance to score from a corner.
52' Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
51' The game is interrupted as Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is flagged offside.
49' Willy Boly (Nottingham) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar.
48' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
47' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Jarred Gillett has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 0 - 1 What a finish that is! Richarlison (Tottenham) latches on to a brilliant cross and gets his head on the ball to put it inside the right post. No chance of stopping that.
45+1' Half-chance! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) plays a pass into the box, but Matt Turner reacts well to snuff out the attack.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
42' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) is booked by the referee.
42' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham), but Matt Turner is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
41' Richarlison (Tottenham) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
37' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
37' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
34' Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
32' No one likes to see incidents like this. Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is taken from the field on a stretcher after what looked like a head injury and is replaced by Oliver Skipp.
28' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Flag up against Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
25' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Ben Davies (Tottenham), but it's just over the bar.
24' The ball goes behind for a corner. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Matt Turner is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
22' Tottenham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
19' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
18' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
15' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
13' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Heung-Min Son (Tottenham).
11' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
9' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
7' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.

6' Neco Williams (Nottingham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jarred Gillett no option but to blow his whistle. Tottenham are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
5' The Tottenham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
3' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Tottenham will kick-off.
Jarred Gillett got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
